name: Can baseboards be nailed directly into basement concrete walls?

mainEntity.name: Can baseboards be nailed directly into basement concrete walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baseboards along basement exterior walls must be anchored into wood studs, wall framing plates, or anchored furring strips. Nailing trim directly into concrete foundation walls can split the trim, bend finish nails, or pull loose over time. Fastening to framing also maintains a necessary thermal and moisture separation between the cold foundation masonry and the interior finish carpentry. Where framing plates sit high, finish carpenters locate the low stud blocks to secure the bottom profile firmly.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, baseboards should be nailed into wood studs or furring strips rather than raw concrete to ensure a secure hold and prevent moisture transfer.
